Author: Nagdy
Message:
Add a bounded LangSmith agent-eval CLI for synthetic development cases.

The tool syncs a versioned development dataset, runs the admitted query graph in-process, and scores with deterministic evaluators plus an optional one-call-per-case judge. Holdout stays sealed and Combined +10pp remains unverified.

Author: Nagdy
Message:
Add GitHub OIDC and protected expand-migration custody so staging can assume only environment-scoped SSM targets without long-lived CI secrets.

Workflows exchange an OIDC token for a short-lived role that may send only named migrate/deploy documents. Live assume and Secrets Manager rotation stay Blocked until AWS is available; expand/contract policy and the prior old-API smoke remain the local proof.
